candidates.title: Prepare a reviewed invoice and time report

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare invoices, follow up customers, report key figures to the owner, and handle time reports.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: sköta fakturering, följa upp kunder och rapportera nyckeltal till ägaren

ease.reason: A student can test invoice field extraction and a review sheet with fictional PDFs; the attached template lists fields and logging, but not time-report handling.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a professional office may value less manual invoice preparation; this vacancy does not establish demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A two-week fictional invoice extraction demo is plausible; the template supports extraction and logging, but not customer follow-up or time-report rules.

autonomy.reason: A workflow can prepare extracted fields and a log as shown in the template; a person must verify figures and handle follow-up and reporting decisions.

evidence.reason: The fresh notice names invoicing, customer follow-up, key figures and time reports; the attached template demonstrates a related invoice extraction and logging pattern, not this office's process.

candidates.reason: Reject as a recent duplicate: the proposed invoice extraction and review-sheet workflow for professional office administration repeats the invoice intake/review workflow in recent post Invoice paperwork check for administrators (31475171). The notice adds follow-up, reporting and time reports, but no attached implementation evidence bounds those as a distinct small workflow.

candidates.title: Prepare an incoming case and document register

demandEvidence.chore: Register and close incoming and outgoing cases, register documents, dispatch them, and archive them.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: hantering av inkommande och utgående ärenden i form av att registrera och avsluta ärenden, registrering av handlingar, expediering och arkivering

ease.reason: A fictional register can be drafted, but the notice supplies no fields or filing rules and no attached reference demonstrates case registration.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a professional office may value case administration support; the paid role does not show demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A fictional intake register is testable in two weeks, but dispatch, case closure and archival rules are missing and cannot be inferred.

autonomy.reason: A prototype could format operator-supplied case rows; a clerk must determine categories, verify records and perform dispatch or closure.

evidence.reason: The fresh notice explicitly lists case registration, document registration, dispatch and archiving, but gives no formats, frequency or process constraints.

candidates.reason: Reject as a recent workflow duplicate: case/document registration and filing repeats Administrator document filing checklist (31551851) and Draft an incoming case document index (31548970). The new notice states more task details but adds no implementation reference or distinct workflow evidence.

candidates.title: Draft a registry entry and archive checklist

demandEvidence.chore: Register and diarize records, then archive them.

ease.reason: A mock checklist can be made, but the notice gives no record fields or filing procedure and no attached implementation reference supports the workflow.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: an office handling records may value filing assistance; this vacancy does not establish AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A fictional record checklist is feasible to sketch, but the notice does not specify inputs, categories or archive constraints for a useful prototype.

autonomy.reason: Software might format a draft register; a records worker must classify, verify and file each item under rules absent from the evidence.

evidence.reason: The fresh notice names registration, diarization and archiving but provides no task examples, fields, frequency or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Reject as a recent workflow duplicate: registry entry and archiving repeats Administrator document filing checklist (31551851). The notice confirms those chores but does not change the missing fields and filing-rule evidence noted in that completed assessment.

rejected.title: Paid administrator role
rejected.reason: The enriched primary notice contains no concrete task excerpt; a role title alone cannot support a bounded demand experiment or invented duties.

rejected.title: Paid administrator role
rejected.reason: The notice says only that the role supports varied administrative, project and everyday tasks; it does not identify a concrete bounded chore to assess.

steps.message: Assessed all five selected demand leads with concrete chores; three received full criterion assessments and two role-only notices were excluded. No proposal clears the novelty and evidence bar: the scoped invoice and document workflows overlap recent completed refusals, so this batch has no post.
